one_line: LLMs gain direct weight control, Anthropic ramps up compute, and AI deals hit new heights.

themes.title: LLMs edit weights and prove outputs
themes.text: MIT researchers showed a large language model can directly modify neural network weights, boosting performance on benchmarks. Anthropic released FlashProve, an open‑source system that generates cryptographic proofs that a model’s reply came from a specific weight set.

stories.headline: MIT researchers show LLMs can read and edit neural network weights without retraining
Anthropic releases FlashProve to cryptographically verify AI model responses

themes.title: Anthropic scales revenue and compute spending
themes.text: Anthropic reported a 1,100% year‑over‑year revenue increase to $17 billion and pledged roughly $895 billion in compute spending, while its compute costs now represent 58% of revenue, widening its operating loss.

stories.headline: Anthropic compute costs rise to 58% of revenue in Q3, widening operating loss
Anthropic reports 1,100% revenue surge ahead of IPO, commits $895B to compute

themes.title: AI‑focused M&A and fundraising surge
themes.text: Salesforce agreed to buy Cresta for $2.7 billion, CrowdStrike announced acquisitions of Fiddler AI and Dreadnode, Fal raised $1.3 billion at a $16 billion valuation, and startups Trajectory and PowerUp Money secured $45 million and $10 million respectively to expand AI services.

stories.headline: Salesforce to acquire Cresta for $2.7 billion
CrowdStrike to acquire Fiddler AI for $400 million and Dreadnode for $95 million
AI inference startup Fal valued at $16B after $1.3B funding round
Trajectory raises $45 million Series A to automate AI model post‑training
PowerUp Money raises $10 million to expand AI‑led wealth management in India
